what: Procedure penalties the owner assigns to the head coach (false start and delay of game on offense, minus deliberate delays before a punt or field goal), priced in win probability with cross-fitted version 2 models, and the test of whether a coach effect exists.

assignment_rule.deliberate_delay_rule: lined up in punt or field-goal formation, or fourth down with the offense's next snap a punt or field goal

pricing: WP(state without the foul) - WP(state with it): same down, clock, score and timeouts; the ball moved back by the enforced yards and the distance lengthened by the same (goal to go: distance = yard line). Development seasons priced by fold models that never saw them; 2024-2025 by the headline model. The 10-second runoff option after a late false start is not priced.

movers_by_stint.note: added after the pre-registered consecutive-season mover check (year_to_year.coach_moved_to_new_team) found only 7 pairs; not part of the verdict rule

mixed_model.method: Poisson, crossed Gaussian random effects, Laplace approximation of the marginal likelihood (coaches.fit_poisson_crossed); expected counts from league rates by season, home or road, dome and third-or-fourth-and-long

verdict.rule: configs/coaches.yaml penalties.verdict (written before the data was read)

notes: Intervals are 90% bootstrap intervals over the coach's games.
The coach effect, if any, includes his staff (offensive line coach, play-caller's tempo), which the data cannot separate from the head coach.
Only the first penalty listed on a play is read (nflverse penalty_type).
